sections.heading: What is trending: “iphone fold”
paragraphs: “iphone fold” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for SE (snapshot taken 2026-09-09T18:36:40+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 200 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Wed, 9 Sep 2026 10:50:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-09-09T18:36:40+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-09-09T18:37:39+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

faq.a: Google's Trending Now feed links the spike to coverage from CNET Japan, NewsPicks, エルミタージュ秋葉原. faq.q: How many people searched for “iphone fold”?
